rows.en:
(Right, today's EX-Gear practical training
with Luca...)
rows.notes: Male, frd_luk_005. EX-Gear and Practical Training (jitsugi) from terms.json.

rows.en:
Luca's not here...
It's been almost 30 minutes...
...Did something happen to him?

I-I'm so sorry!!
I'm late...
Luca, what happened?
Getting Samson ready took longer than I expected...
Hm? Aren't you used to handling EX-Gear by now?

There's no such thing as getting used to it!
Every day comes with its own conditions!

Anyway, let's start the flight training!
We can't afford to waste any more time!
(Wasn't Luca the one who showed up late...?)
Ahh, I'm tired.
Thanks to you, that was great training.
Huh? Really?

You fly right by the fundamentals, Luca.
I learn a lot from watching you.
Really? Hehe.

Plus, how do I put it... you leave yourself
in the EX-Gear's hands.
It always looks so natural.

People can't fly if they can't trust
their machines, after all.
Yeah, that's true.
Look, just look at Samson!
Hm? Luca?

It's not just functional beauty pursued
to the extreme, but these supple,
beautiful lines!

An EX-Gear that never fails to enchant
all who see it...

I owe its developers more than
I could ever repay!
rows.notes: x2, Luca; idiom ashi o mukete nemurenai (deeply indebted).

rows.en: C-calm down, Luca...

I am calm!
Ahh, it feels so nice to the touch...

Machines aren't something for people to use.
What matters is accepting them as another
form of life that coexists with us.
rows.notes: x2, Luca. shieki = put to work/use as a servant.

rows.en: Do that, and you'll get better at handling machines.
I-is that so...?
It is.
(H-he's dead certain...)

Well then, I'm going to do some maintenance
on Samson before I head home.
O-okay, see you later then.
(Luca's love for machines is truly formidable...)

(Right, today's EX-Gear practical training
with Luca-kun...)

Luca-kun isn't here...
It's been almost 30 minutes, you know...
Geez! Keeping a girl waiting...
Luca-kun, is something wrong?
Huh? Aren't you used to handling EX-Gear by now?
Oh, yeah...
rows.notes: x3: also male player in frd_nns_002 (Nanase raving about Ranka's tea) and frd_nns_003 ('we're classmates, aren't we!').

rows.en: (Wasn't Luca-kun the one who showed up late...?)
Haah, that was tiring.
Thanks to you, I think that was great training.

You fly right by the fundamentals, Luca-kun.
I learn a lot from watching you.
Huh? Luca-kun?
C-calm down, Luca-kun...
(H-he's dead certain...)
O-okay, see you later then.

(Luca-kun's love for machines is truly
formidable...)
(More EX-Gear practice with Luca today!)

\p-san,
you're late!
rows.notes: x3: Luca (both genders) and Shirakawa in frd_myk_006 (female).

rows.en: Whoa, you're raring to go, Luca.

Of course!
I'm not going easy on you today.
Bring it on.

...Good work~
I didn't think we'd fly for this long...
I did say I wasn't going easy on you.

Well then, I'm going to go do
some maintenance on Samson.

(I might not want to see an EX-Gear
for a while...)
(More EX-Gear practice with Luca-kun today!)
Whoa, you're raring to go, Luca-kun.
Bring it on!
